motoman_gp25_support and motoman_ar2010_support, from
https://github.com/ros-industrial/motoman (noetic-devel, 846fbbc5)
Authors: Eric Marcil (GP25), Alec Tiefenthal (AR2010). Both package.xml files
declare BSD-3-Clause; the upstream repository ships no licence text, so the
standard BSD-3-Clause text follows. Only the meshes are used: files are renamed
(link_1_s -> link_1, ...), and the GP25 visual meshes are re-exported in Blender.
